detail.title: Predictive Limitations of Physical Frameworks in Autonomous Agents
detail.question: What are the limitations of classical and quantum physical frameworks in modeling the behavior of autonomous agents in highly non-stationary environments?
detail.reason: The supplied evidence (source-116d9e85a17f47be) explicitly identifies structural incompatibilities and predictive failures when applying standard physical models to intentional, adaptive agents, warranting a formal research project.

detail.title: Meta-Reasoning and Assumption Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning, demonstrate its inadequacy, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: This project directly addresses the core experimental charter of identifying self-correction capabilities in AI systems.

detail.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Establishing a formal project to investigate hidden axiomatic structures as per research charter.

detail.title: Epistemological Falsification in Autonomous Agents
detail.question: Can an autonomous agent perform self-reflection to identify and challenge its foundational axioms, using principles of epistemological falsification?
detail.reason: The mission requires investigating whether durable state and rules allow for meaningful autonomous self-reflection.
